title: Tailwise Pharmacy Dispensing-Error Refund: Care Console Action Reference
content:
## Scope

This Tailwise Pharmacy action prices and books the refund owed on a dispensed fill that carries a confirmed dispensing-error claim, where the prescription's class does not allow a free remake, so that a refund is the remedy the pharmacy owes as soon as the claim is confirmed within the report window. It covers a claim recorded on the most recent dispensed fill of a prescription, and that fill is the claimed fill; the claim's error type is the error recorded on that fill.

The refund is paid to the original payment, and the refunded fill is credited back to the prescription's fills remaining.

## Invocation

The refund is booked with the agent tool `refund_dispensing_error_93fa9db7`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; it is an agent action, not a customer hand-over.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_prescription_id` | the prescription reference number the erroneous fill belongs to, as returned by the prescription lookup for the customer | reference number |
| `original_event_id` | the pharmacy ledger reference number of the dispensed fill being refunded, as returned by the pharmacy ledger lookup for that prescription | reference number |
| `error_type` | the dispensing error this refund remedies | exactly one value of the closed set below |
| `amount_usd` | the total amount refunded to the original payment for this fill | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

Values of `error_type`:

- `wrong_medication`: a different medication or diet was dispensed than the one prescribed.
- `wrong_strength`: the right medication was dispensed at a strength or formula other than the prescribed one.
- `wrong_quantity`: the number of packages dispensed differs from the packages billed for the fill.
- `wrong_label`: the product was right but its label carries wrong information.
- `none`: the fill carries no dispensing error at all; it never describes a refund and is listed only to complete the closed set.

## Return

On success the tool returns `refund_event_id` (reference number of the refund entry on the pharmacy ledger), `credit_event_id` (reference number of the fill credit-back entry), `original_event_id` (the refunded fill), `amount_usd` (the amount refunded, 2 decimal places), `refund_method` (always `original_payment`), `fills_remaining` (the prescription's fills still available including the credit-back) and `status` (`refunded` when the entries are booked).

## Observable effect

One call books, dated today, a refund entry against the named fill on the prescription's pharmacy ledger — carrying the refunded amount, the error being remedied and refund to the original payment — and a matching fill credit-back entry for the same fill carrying that fill's days' supply. The prescription then shows one more fill still available, and the refund is on its way to the card or account the fill was paid with.

## Contract questions

**Does the tool decide whether the claim qualifies or work out the amount?**
No. The tool books the entries with the values passed; the amount and the error type are passed by the caller.

**Where does the refund go?**
Always to the original payment.
